text: Meet TontinePilot, the AI copilot for community savings groups. The dashboard shows this cycle's collection, who paid, and who still owes.
Declare a payment in plain English. Just type: I paid twenty thousand for Awa. The AI extracts the amount and the recipient.
Run several savings groups side by side. Switch in one click, archive the paused ones, or create a new group in two minutes.
Every member gets a trust score. Reliable payers collect early. Chronic late payers move later in the rotation.
Late payments trigger kind, automatic reminders. And the audio digest reads the whole cycle summary out loud.
Export the full ledger to a spreadsheet in one click. No more arguments about who paid what.
And Tonti, the built-in assistant, answers live questions and nudges late members for you.
TontinePilot. Community savings, minus the drama.
